from pathlib import Path
import re
files=list(Path('.').glob('**/src/main/**/*.java'))
pat=re.compile(r'(\"(?:\\\\.|["'^"'"\\\\])*\"|\\'(?:\\\\.|["'^'"\\'\\\\])*\\'|/\\*.*?\\*/|//["'^'"\\n]*)',re.S)
by_simple={}; infos=[]
for z,p in enumerate(files):
 s=p.read_text(errors='ignore'); c=pat.sub(' ',s)
 pkg=(re.search(r'\\bpackage\\s+([\\w.]+)\\s*;',c) or [None,''])[1]
 decl=list(re.finditer(r'\\b(?:public\\s+|protected\\s+|private\\s+|abstract\\s+|final\\s+|static\\s+|sealed\\s+|non-sealed\\s+)*\\b(class|interface|enum|record)\\s+(\\w+)',c))
 if not decl: continue
 name=decl[0].group(2); fqn=f'{pkg}.{name}' if pkg else name
 infos.append((p,s,c,pkg,name,fqn))
 by_simple.setdefault(name,[]).append(fqn)
print('infos',len(infos),'simples',len(by_simple),flush=True)
PY"
